findings.note: Blust is listed as a sponsor (not the primary sponsor) of HB 825, Election Improvements. The date is the first-edition date; the page does not say when he signed on. The bill would change what a voter must give to request an absentee ballot: the last four digits of a Social Security number plus a driver license number, state ID card number or date of birth. It would also let a voter who cannot attach a photocopy of ID to a returned absentee ballot use a reasonable-impediment affidavit with the same identifiers. The same bill bans ranked choice voting and shortens early voting. It stayed in the Rules committee.

findings.note: Blust is listed among the sponsors of HB 958, Election Law Changes. The date is the filing date; the first version listed only the primary sponsor, so the page does not say when he joined. The ratified bill requires a voter registration application to state affirmatively that the applicant is a U.S. citizen before it is processed, and requires a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database. The Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17.
